According to reports, new Apple products will be released on October 13, including the rumored "HomePad" device. However, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, one rumored product will not debut next month: a new full-size HomePod equipped with Siri AI.

The full-size HomePod will not be updated in October, but Bloomberg says a new version will "eventually" be released

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported today that Apple plans to announce three brand-new home products soon.

The upcoming new products include:

October 13 (Tuesday) is the expected announcement date for each product.

However, one major home product will not be launched in October. Gurman wrote:

This is his only mention of the full-size HomePod product, which has not been updated since 2023.

Most-liked comment posted by OliveBus

Just updated my HomePod to v27 (24J361). Bought it years ago, and the sound quality is still outstanding. Paired with an AppleTV Gen2 and a Bose sound system featuring a wireless subwoofer and two rear speakers, using AirPlay to set up a stereo combination.

On the fence about the new product—hopefully it's worth the wait, and please don't break the existing Homies when updating.

Earlier this year, Gurman reported that a new-generation full-size HomePod is being developed alongside an updated HomePod mini and the Apple TV 4K. When asked when it would be released, he said: "It's only a matter of time. They want to make sure Apple Intelligence and the new Siri features work properly on these products before launching the new versions."

However, despite Siri AI having already officially launched, and the HomePod mini also being ready, fans of the full-size HomePod will apparently have to wait a while longer before they can get their hands on updated hardware compatible with Siri AI.

Hopefully the wait won't be too long, because in just a few weeks, the full-size HomePod will be the only home product still stuck with the old version of Siri.

Which new Apple home product are you most looking forward to? Are you planning to buy a new HomePod? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
